instruction: Look at open_shell_box.dxf. Draw an upward-opening cap-like shell section on layer OUTLINE by connecting the vertices (0,0), (140,0), (140,70), (120,70), (120,20), (20,20), (20,70), and (0,70) in order with straight line segments. In the bottom of the cap, represent one through drain hole in section as a diameter 12 circle centered at (70,10) on layer HOLE. Add text ACAD-09 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
